answer_1.quote: Data-to-Text refers to the process of generating accurate and fluent natural language text from structured data such as tables, lists, graphs etc.
answer_1.outputs: fluent text that is firmly grounded in the MR

answer_2.quote: Following prior work, we use the suite of word-overlap-based automatic metrics from the E2E NLG Challenge, supporting BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr.

answer_4.quote: Since automatic metrics have been shown to be inadequate for generation tasks, we also conduct human evaluations on a set of 200 examples randomly sampled from the test set. Concretely, we measure two metrics -accuracy and fluency
answer_4.guideline: Human raters are shown the gold text and the predicted text and are instructed to mark the generated text as accurate if it correctly conveys the meaning of the gold text. We show the predicted text to raters and ask them how natural and fluent the text sounds on a 1-5 scale, with 5 being the highest score.
